predictions: Whitespace tokens of 44-56 spaces before a trailing comment or '*' border reach 0.3-0.6; the same lines padded with 16-20 spaces stay under 0.1.
short: long whitespace padding to a column
notes: Card: peaks on runs of 40-52 spaces (,DST.CERTID [44 sp] --证件号, SMTP = "" [43 sp] # ..., Copyright (c) 2011 [51 sp] *); 4-space runs only reach 0.15-0.17 of max. Probe: 50-space run before '*' 0.521, 43-space run before '--' 0.370; 33-space run 0.035, 20-space run 0.015, single space 0.009. The run length seems to matter more than the comment.
